metadata.method: Two fresh-worker rounds per family and API, Carve-Djot-CommonMark then CommonMark-Djot-Carve. Serial workers; 60s group deadline including startup; 200ms warmup per size, five batches of at least 20ms with 16-call time checks, GC before batches. Each round remains in the raw data. Render reuses a prebuilt AST. CPU includes all process threads. RSS is cumulative peak.
